FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF LOCAL PLAN

(ALTERATION)) RULES 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 16 and paragraph 64(2)(j)

of the Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner of the City of

Kuala Lumpur, with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning) (Fee for

Purchase of Local Plan (Alteration)) Rules 2020.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 1 July 2020.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the Kuala Lumpur City Plan 2020 (Alteration)

shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

Copy Fee per copy

(RM)

Hard copy 100.00

Electronic form 50.00

Made 26 June 2020

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/808 JLD. 5; PN(PU2)396/VIII]

DATO' NOR HISHAM BIN A DAHLAN

Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur

Approved 26 June 2020
